summary: Compared the assigned source record, reference, rendered crop, diff crop, geometry and crop metric for archive-filters. Outer geometry passes with +1 px Y delta and crop diff is 7.6604%, but the filter internals visibly diverge in hierarchy, control alignment and scroll viewport.
issues: PA-FILTERS-001 [P1] hierarchy/layout: expected the sourced category hierarchy with bullets, chevrons, a green active Fungicydy row and indented crop children; actual list is flattened and omits these visual states. Fix: restore the native category hierarchy and source controls.

PA-FILTERS-002 [P1] controls/overflow: expected checkboxes inline with labels and ten active-substance rows visible inside a scroll viewport; actual checkboxes break above labels and the visible list ends at Florasulam. Fix: restore row alignment and the source list viewport/scroll sizing.
PA-FILTERS-003 [P2] price control: expected a dash separator between the od and do fields; actual control omits it. Fix: restore the sourced separator and spacing.
